rule: V2 hysteresis on dataset gripper command (normalized opening, 1.0=open): <=0.6 -> close(+1), >=0.8 -> open(-1), deadband hold, min-hold 5 frames
interpretation: On real expert commands the V2 rule yields clean two-phase gripper semantics: open before the first grasp, closed through carry, open at every release (1037 releases over 845 episodes implies multi-release episodes, consistent with two batches per episode), and zero one-frame pulses. Raw joint actions are still not used as supervision; 7D will be built from eef_pose with the gripper mapped via this same hysteresis.
limits: This validates label semantics on recorded commands, not closed-loop control. pm1 mapping threshold must be frozen before training.
